Definition: of Hebrew origin (H8559); Thamar (i.e. Tamar), an Israelitess:--Thamar.
BiblicalUsage: Thamar is Tamar, the daughter-in-law of Judah, named in the genealogy of Jesus. In Matthew 1:3, Judas begat Phares and Zara of Thamar.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Tamar matters because God works through ordinary people, and no name in His book is there by accident. That is why I keep coming back to this name when I read the genealogy and the Gospels.
